judgment_calls: Heading metadata nodes: created separate authority nodes for each section (n001, n009) rather than one document-wide node, because each heading governs only its own section.
Worked examples (n008, n017, n019) treated as single nodes needing the section authority, not decomposed into the dialog inside them.
n021 split from n020 because the second sentence is a factual justification (reduces efficiency, may be condescending) rather than a rule with the same modal.

n014 kept as one node though it contains both a fact (hard token limits) and a should-rule (avoid incomplete responses), because the should-rule is the claim and the fact is its premise; could have split but the sentence is one claim about avoiding interruption.
n010 (competing considerations) kept as a fact node; it frames the section but establishes no rule.
